steps.speaker: And you... could you be my auspicious star?
steps.content: Match... Match point... Winning side, ${PlayerName} serves...

steps.speaker: Four-leaf Clover Judge
steps.content: Roulecca... is six points short.
You can't tell if Roulecca is panting out of exhaustion or anxiety. She sweats profusely as she stares at you both nervously and stubbornly.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: If you keep this up, you'll lose.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm really going to take away your family. You'll never see your daddy again.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Roulecca won't lose!

The moment you toss the ball into the air, a seagull sweeps across the sky beneath the dazzling sun, casting a flash of blinding light into your eyes. The ball falls, snaps your finger, and hits your forehead.

steps.speaker: Four-leaf Clover Judge
steps.content: Fweet! Service fault by ${PlayerName}! A point for the four-leaf clover family!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: What are you waiting for? Keep the match going! It's my turn to serve. Roulecca's going to make a comeback!
Wobbling, she takes the ball and serves it with all her strength. The ball floats softly, hits the white boundary line and twists a few times—then jumps over the line and lands on your side!

steps.speaker: Four-leaf Clover Judge
steps.content: ...Good serve! Well-played, Roulecca! A point for the four-leaf clover family!
There has been a change in the situation.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Are you interfering with the rules here again?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: How rude! Roulecca didn't cheat! That was luck!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Like I said, Roulecca is always the luckiest one! I won't lose to anyone! I won't let you take them away!
Her eyes flash with a frenzy and persistence that you are all too familiar with. Something is gradually awakening within her.
Things aren't going according to plan, but maybe... it's better this way.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Great. Keep enjoying the game, Roulecca.

steps.content: All the way till you regain what you have lost.

steps.speaker: Four-leaf Clover Judge
steps.content: In! What a stunning arc! What a spectacular volley! A point for the four-leaf clover family!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ${PlayerName} clips the net... but fails! Tsk tsk tsk, what an unlucky guy. Another point for the four-leaf clover family!
steps.female_content: ${PlayerName} clips the net... but fails! Tsk tsk tsk, what an unlucky lady. Another point for the four-leaf clover family!

steps.speaker: Four-leaf Clover Judge
steps.content: The serve clips the net! Roulecca scores twice! A point for the four-leaf clover family!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Wow! My serve went over the net! It's in! Daddy, I scored a point! My good luck is real! A point for the four-leaf clover family!

steps.speaker: Four-leaf Clover Judge
steps.content: Net fault for ${PlayerName}! A point for the four-leaf clover family! The four-leaf clover family is now in the lead!

You protest loudly, pointing at the strange hermit crab pinching your heels. When you were rushing towards the ball, it suddenly appeared and pinched you. You lost your balance and fell face first into the net.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Mm-hmm, nice excuse. Fine then. Roulecca'll let you off this time. Let's try again.
One minute later.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Wooo! Out again for ${PlayerName}! Match point for the four-leaf clover family! Roulecca is going to win!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Daddy, look! We're going to win!
Her little face is bright red from all the excitement. She takes her father's hand and skips around in happiness.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: So, Chief Dumb-Dumb... Did you see the powers of the goddess of luck?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I did. You really are the goddess of luck.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hehehe... You don't know who you're messing with! I have the super duper invincible good luck from all the four-leaf clover family! There's no way I'd lose to you!
Around her, there are no more black four-leaf clovers dissipating.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As expected of a Sinner with the power of Unbeatable Luck. You've regained the power that you discarded.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...Huh?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you remember why you discarded it? Did it bring you a lot of pain?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Shut up!
She stands up abruptly and points her water gun at you, which has somehow turned into a revolver.
Roulecca notices the transformation, and throws away the gun in shock.
Someone else picks it up silently.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: This is the birthday gift promised to you, Roulecca. Your father kept his promise and gave you this revolver.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Do you recall what happened that day?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: No, no... I don't want to! I don't want this kind of luck...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I don't want luck in exchange for Daddy and everyone else... I just want you guys... Don't leave me...

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Wake up, Roulecca. This isn't your world. Your real father is no longer with you.
The pink sea begins to distort, and cracks form in the sky. Once punctured, the beautiful dream can never go back to the way it was.
Your shackles react. Sinner S-666, the super lucky Roulecca, has woken up...
